newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Optus says sells stake in service provider.
newsitem.headline: Optus says sells stake in service provider.

text.p: Optus Communications Pty Ltd said on Wednesday it had sold its 28.5 percent stake in service provider One.Tel and signed an agreement which will continue the commercial relationship for at least a further four years.

"The other One.Tel shareholders were keen to increase their stakes, and we felt it was important that Optus be a supplier of network services without the ties of an equity interest in one of the players," chief executive Ziggy Switkowksi said.
Switkowski said in a statement that Optus would continue to be One.Tel's exclusive supplier of GSM mobile digital services and to supply long distance services.
Optus said One.Tel was started in May 1995 to serve residential and small to medium business customers and now has 100,000 customers.
The company did not disclose terms or say which other firm had purchased the stake.
